verdict.rationale: Discord's own docs confirm Threads let conversations branch off a channel's main feed for organized sub-topics (discord-docs-37/38/45) and Replies help pinpoint responses in busy channels (discord-docs-44), directly supporting the story. However, independent community evidence concretely contradicts the 'catch up efficiently' claim: users report content in Discord has no discoverability and information gets buried and unsearchable in busy servers (discord-comm-3, discord-comm-7), undermining the admin's ability to efficiently catch up despite threads/topics existing. missing for 10: first-party evidence of thread/channel search or unread-tracking tools, and independent corroboration that threads actually solve catch-up efficiency rather than just organizing at time of posting.
